messages:
Alex: AM check-in — shipped query-routing spec draft to the docs site (link: https://redwood.dev/specs/query-routing). Need final perf numbers from infra to lock canary thresholds.
Ria: saw the draft, looks good overall. can you add a short table with expected p50/p95 per tier? makes it easier for infra to map SLAs.
Alex: good call — adding now. will ping infra once table is in.
Sam: quick FYI, I'm blocked on the PR for the fallback policy — waiting on a small test harness change from eng-infra. 
Marta: for UX: can we keep the feature flag name stable? last-minute renames broke the dashboard once. request: feature flag = `routing.v2.canary` if ok.
Alex: +1 keep that name. I'll update spec and rollout checklist.
Ria: infra asked whether we can tolerate 250ms cold-start for low tier during burst hours. Alex — can the spec call out fallback to smaller model when latency > 300ms?
Alex: yes, adding fallback rule: if endpoint latency > 300ms for >1m, route to `model-compact-v1` for 10% of traffic, then ramp to 50% if persisted. will include rollback criteria.
Sam: pinging @marta — quick review on the UX copy for the canary toggle? small copy tweak in the PR.
Marta: saw it; will leave a comment in the PR today.
Sam: thanks — once infra merges the test harness I'll re-run e2e and cut the canary PR.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window set for 2026-04-02 08:00-10:00 UTC per calendar invite.
Alex: note for launch prep — please get CRs in by EOD today for any changes to routing rules. I'll do a final pass tomorrow morning and merge before the canary window. :thumbsup:
Ria: added the p50/p95 table and a short note about expected token distributions. posting a snippet here:
```
Tier    p50   p95
low     80ms  220ms
mid     60ms  140ms
high    35ms   70ms
```
Alex: perfect, thanks. that helps.
Marta: removing one tiny copy nit, otherwise LGTM.
Sam: will update the PR and re-run.
Alex: blockers summary: waiting on eng-infra test harness (Sam); finalize canary thresholds (Ria + infra); UX copy tiny changes (Marta). Planning: complete edits today, final review tomorrow AM, run canary Apr 2.
Ria: thanks — ping here if anything slips.
Marta: +1.
Sam: on it, ETA 5pm PT.
